items: 48 V LiFePO4 server-rack battery bank (10–20 kWh)
why: ChatGPT says its carded power stations are only starting points: whole-house backup also needs added batteries, solar panels and transfer equipment. It ends by asking whether the shopper wants outage backup or daily off-grid power, since the right system differs. What decides the set is 240 V split-phase output, a battery sized in kWh to daily use (its table gives 20–30 kWh for a medium home), and enough panel wattage to refill it. Sun Gold Power's store sells uncarded single-cart answers at different sizes: the SGR-8K10E kit (10.24 kWh), the SGR-10K20E kit (20.48 kWh), or the 6.5 kW hybrid inverter with the SG48100P 4-pack, breaker and bus bar.
